title: The Trainee
logline: On Pretzel Day the pretzel man sends a trainee who keeps botching Stanley's order, Michael polls the line on whether a kiss that 'never happened' happened, and Pam asks Jim to help pick her wedding invitations.
outline: A: Michael can't stop asking the pretzel line, hypothetically, whether a kiss that 'didn't happen' happened; Jan's fax settles it. B: In line, Pam asks Jim to help choose wedding invitations, and Roy doesn't care which. C: A new pretzel trainee ruins Stanley's order twice, until Kevin, of all people, takes over the cart. Order: cold, A, C, B, A, C, B, A, C, A, B, tag
storySoFar: On Pretzel Day a nervous trainee, Tyler, botched Stanley's order twice until Kevin took over the cart with surgical precision; Stanley thanked him. Michael polled the pretzel line about a 'hypothetical' parking-lot kiss (everyone guessed Jan); Jan called to ask if he was telling people, then faxed 'It didn't happen. P.S. Good work on the county account', which Michael is framing. Pam asked Jim to help pick wedding invitations; they chose the plain one with leaves, but Roy said to go with his mom's swan. Pam kept the leaf one in her drawer. Dwight and Angela secretly split a pretzel in the kitchen. Earlier: Michael promised the office no layoffs while corporate decides between Scranton and Stamford; Jim mentioned Stamford would take him; Kelly says she's dating Ryan, who says she isn't.

extras.name: Tyler Dombrowski
extras.title: Pretzel Trainee
extras.voice: Nineteen, nervous, first week on the job, apologizes constantly, mixes up toppings.

stateChanges.progress: Jan faxed 'It didn't happen. P.S. Good work'; Michael is framing it
Jim helped pick Pam's wedding invitations; Roy chose the swan; Pam kept Jim's pick in her drawer

stateChanges.text: Pam keeps the leaf wedding invitation Jim picked in her desk drawer
Kevin knows exactly how to make Stanley's pretzel
Pretzel Day: Stanley's order is original, sweet glaze, cinnamon sugar, chocolate drizzle in a zigzag

scenes.recap: Stanley arrives at 7 a.m. to be first in the Pretzel Day line, and Kevin is already there.

beats.text: PRETZEL DAY. 7:02 AM
Kevin. How long have you been here.
Since six. I brought a pillow. And a backup pillow.
I respect it. I don't like it. But I respect it.

lines: Pretzel Day is the one day a year I come to work happy.
Don't talk to me about it. You'll ruin it.

scenes.recap: Michael asks Dwight, 'hypothetically', whether a kiss that a woman says never happened, happened.

beats.text: Dwight. Hypothetically. A woman kisses a man in a parking lot. Then says it never happened. Did it happen?
Was there a witness?
A Subaru.
Then it's your word against hers. And the Subaru's.

lines: It happened. I was there. My lips were there.
But Jan says it didn't. And Jan is my boss. So legally, I'm not sure.

scenes.recap: The pretzel man's new trainee, Tyler, takes Stanley's order and gets it wrong.

beats.text: Hi! Sorry. I'm Tyler. Sal's sick. I'm new. Sorry.
Original. Sweet glaze. Cinnamon sugar. Then the chocolate drizzle. Not the other way.

beats.caption: assembles a pretzel in a panic and hands it over

beats.text: This is salt. You put salt on it.
Sorry! Sorry. Salt is the default. Sorry.

scenes.recap: In line, Pam asks Jim to help her choose wedding invitations, since Roy won't.

beats.caption: fans out three cream-colored invitation samples

beats.text: Okay, help me. Roy says they're all the same. They are not all the same.
This one has a swan. Do you want a swan at your wedding?
Nobody wants a swan. The swan was his mom's idea.
Then this one. The plain one. With the little leaves. It looks like you drew it.
That's the one I liked.

lines: I helped pick out Pam's wedding invitations today.
Great. It was great. The leaves are nice.

scenes.recap: Michael polls the pretzel line about his 'hypothetical' kiss, and everybody guesses it's Jan.

beats.text: Quick survey. A man and a woman. A parking lot. A kiss. She says it never happened. Go.
Is this about Jan?
No. Who? No. It's about a friend. Named... Mjan.
If she says it didn't happen, she wants it to not have happened. That's different.
Happens to me all the time. I just say it didn't happen too. Everybody wins.
I kissed a woman in a parking lot once. Turned out to be a parking lot attendant. Married her.

scenes.recap: Stanley's second attempt is worse; he sits in silent mourning.

beats.text: Again. Original. Sweet glaze. Cinnamon sugar. Chocolate drizzle.

beats.caption: builds a pretzel with shaking hands

beats.text: Here you go! I did the drizzle first. For flavor. Sorry.
Stanley? Stanley, are you okay?
Leave me alone, Kevin. I'm grieving.

scenes.recap: Roy stops by reception; Pam shows him the invitation she and Jim picked, and Roy says just pick anything.

beats.text: Roy, I picked one. The plain one, with the leaves. Jim helped.
Great. Cool. Whatever you want, babe. Just not the swan, my mom'll ask.
So, the swan?
Yeah. Do the swan. Easier. See you at five.

scenes.recap: Jan calls to ask if Michael is telling people; he lies badly, then invites her to Pretzel Day.

beats.text: Jan! No. I'm not telling people. What would I tell people? About what? Nothing happened.
Phyllis said that? Phyllis is a known liar. She knits.
Anyway, it's Pretzel Day. If you were here, I'd get you a pretzel. With anything. Hello? Jan?

lines: She hung up. Which is what you do when you have feelings and you're on a phone.

scenes.recap: Kevin steps behind the cart and teaches Tyler Stanley's order with total precision; Stanley gets his perfect pretzel.

beats.text: Tyler. Step aside. I've watched Sal for six years.

beats.caption: glazes, sugars and drizzles a pretzel like a surgeon

beats.text: Glaze to the edge. Sugar while it's wet. Drizzle in a zigzag. Never a circle. Circles are for amateurs.

beats.caption: takes one bite and closes his eyes

beats.text: Kevin. Thank you.
Kevin, that's the most competent thing I've ever seen you do.

lines: People think I'm not good at anything. I'm good at a lot of things.
Pretzels. Drums. Knowing which vending machine row gives two.

scenes.recap: A fax arrives from Jan: 'It didn't happen. Good work on the county account.' Michael treasures it.

beats.caption: hands Michael a fax from corporate

beats.text: From Jan. It says, 'It didn't happen. P.S. Good work on the county account.'
She wrote a P.S. Pam. Do you know what a P.S. means?
Post script?
It means 'Psst. Something.' It means something.

lines: I'm framing this fax. Next to my Dundie. And my other Dundie.
It didn't happen. But she wrote about it not happening. That's a love letter.

scenes.recap: At the end of the day, Pam quietly puts the swan invitation in her bag and the leaf one in her drawer.

beats.caption: puts the leaf invitation in her desk drawer, and the swan one in her bag

beats.text: So. Swan.
Swan. It's fine. It's just paper.
We do sell paper. I could get you a deal on non-swan paper.

scenes.recap: Dwight and Angela secretly share one pretzel in the kitchen, and spring apart when the door opens.

beats.caption: splits one pretzel exactly in half with a pocketknife

beats.text: Cinnamon sugar on your half. Salt on mine. As agreed.
Thank you, D.
And THAT is why the Loyalty Task Force needs more staples. Good day.
